description: bits-ui's ToggleGroup of type single compiled from its published source through shadcn-svelte's unmodified toggle-group wrappers and the toggle-group-outline and toggle-group-spacing demos (spacing through the --gap custom property, items from an each block over a const tuple), and a vertical outline group bound to the app's string. Pressed by clicks (pressing the pressed item clears the value), by Space and Enter on the focused item; arrow keys move focus through bits-ui's roving focus group (ArrowDown/ArrowUp in the vertical group, looping), Home and End; set from outside through the bound value; onValueChange counts the group's own changes. aria-checked, role radio, data-state, tabindex (roving, following the pressed item), the pressed backgrounds and focus rings (pixel regions)
